more_info.overview: Carbamide, also called urea, is a defined nitrogen-containing organic compound supplied as crystals or small pellets. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties. EU permissions include chewing gum.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain chewing gum.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
